references.text: Identical commandment that repeats the instruction to bring the firstfruits to the Lord's house and the prohibition against boiling a young goat in its mother's milk.
Repeats the prohibition against boiling a young goat in its mother's milk, as part of Israel's holiness statutes.
Detailed description of the ritual for bringing the firstfruits of the land's harvest to the Lord's house.
Related commandment to give the firstfruits and the firstborn to the Lord without delay.
The firstfruits of oil, wine, and grain are to be given to the Lord and belong to the priests.
Encouragement to honor the Lord with the firstfruits of all your harvest.
Regulations concerning the firstfruit offering and how it is to be presented before the Lord.
Commandment to bring the firstfruits of the harvest as a wave offering for the Lord.
